title: SMS delayed delivery by 2 hours
symptom: SMS bolus command was delayed by 2 hours: a 0.10 bolus sent around 12:30 did not deliver until 15:00, and a subsequent 0.75 bolus was not delivered.
evidence_quote: The bolus did not deliver. Later in the afternoon when I tried to bolus 0.75 (15:00) the SMS delivered the missing 0.10 instead. The 0.75 has not been delivered.
